entries.5c58302bb73bd8c6: This is the main product group used in the food industry, such as beer-type beverages, soft drinks, sweeteners and seasonings, in the pharmaceutical industry for antibiotics and others, in the chemical industry for fats and oils and synthetic resins, and at waste incineration plants.
